hypothesis: Rotation of a gyroscope changes apparent-weight readings beyond pre-specified instrument and environmental uncertainty.
null_hypothesis: Mean apparent-weight difference between rotating and matched control conditions is zero within the pre-specified equivalence margin.
primary_outcome: Within-block difference in mean balance reading (mg), rotating condition minus motor-off control.
randomization: Computer-generated balanced block order; allocation concealed from the analyst.
blinding: Analyst receives coded condition labels until data cleaning and primary analysis are frozen.
primary_test: Two-sided paired/block-aware model; report effect in mg, 95% CI, raw data, and standardized effect.
exclusion_rules: Exclude only documented sensor failure or pre-defined environmental excursions.
Never exclude based on effect direction or statistical significance.
safety: Guard rotating parts; secure rotor; remote operation; emergency stop; no human exposure to hazardous speeds.
